groups.name: aiact
groups.description: Top-level configuration for the spring-aiact starter. Disabling aiact.enabled fully turns off the AOP advisor, the audit log, the REST endpoints and the retention scheduler.

groups.name: aiact.hmac
groups.description: HMAC chain configuration. The secret is the only thing standing between a tampered audit log and a clean one; treat it like a master key.

groups.name: aiact.encryption
groups.description: Encryption-at-rest. v1.0 placeholder, not implemented in v0.1. Rely on filesystem encryption (LUKS, EFS-at-rest, EBS-encrypted) until the implementation lands.

groups.name: aiact.retention-sweeper
groups.description: Daily retention sweeper that prunes records older than aiact.retention. Disable in tests and in deployments that prune externally.

properties.name: aiact.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the starter. When false the entire AI Act surface is inactive.

properties.name: aiact.log-dir
properties.description: Directory holding the per-system NDJSON audit files. Must be writable by the application user. On Kubernetes, point to a persistent volume; never to an ephemeral emptyDir.

properties.name: aiact.retention
properties.description: Retention horizon for the Article 12 audit log. Default aligns with the Article 47 declaration of conformity archival window. Format ISO-8601, for example P10Y or P6M.

properties.name: aiact.endpoints.enabled
properties.description: When false, the /aiact/log/** and /aiact/oversight/** controllers are not registered.

properties.name: aiact.endpoints.base-path
properties.description: Path prefix for the spring-aiact REST endpoints. Change only when colliding with an existing route.

properties.name: aiact.endpoints.allow-without-guard
properties.description: When true, the starter wires the unsafe AllowAllAiActEndpointGuard. Use only in local development. Production deployments must register a custom AiActEndpointGuard bean.

properties.name: aiact.hmac.secret
properties.description: Plain-text HMAC secret. In production prefer aiact.hmac.secret-ref pointing at a Vault / KMS reference. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`.

properties.name: aiact.hmac.secret-ref
properties.description: Optional reference to a Spring Cloud Config / Vault key. Resolution is deployer specific.

properties.name: aiact.hmac.fail-on-default-in-prod
properties.description: When true (default), the auto-configuration refuses to start if aiact.hmac.secret is still the placeholder value 'change-me-please' and no development profile is active. Turn off only for emergency hotfix scenarios.

properties.name: aiact.hmac.development-profiles
properties.description: Profile names where the default HMAC secret is tolerated. Lower-case match.

properties.name: aiact.encryption.enabled
properties.description: Reserved for v1.0. Setting this to true in v0.1 has no effect; do not interpret as live encryption-at-rest.

properties.name: aiact.encryption.key-ref
properties.description: Reserved for v1.0. Reference to a key handle (KMS arn, Vault path, JKS alias).

properties.name: aiact.encryption.algorithm
properties.description: Reserved for v1.0. JCA cipher transformation. Currently unused.

properties.name: aiact.audit.single-writer-lock
properties.description: When true (default), every audit append acquires an OS-level FileLock and tails the file under the lock to recompute the chain head from disk. Required when more than one pod / JVM writes to the same NDJSON file. Imposes one fsync-class operation per append (~1-3 ms on local SSD).

properties.name: aiact.audit.sink
properties.description: Backend that persists the Article 12 audit log. ndjson (default) writes a per-system file under aiact.log-dir; jdbc persists the same HMAC-chained records to the aiact_audit_log table of the application DataSource, surviving scale-to-zero / ephemeral runtimes where the local filesystem does not.

properties.name: aiact.audit.jdbc.auto-ddl
properties.description: JDBC sink only. When true (default), the starter runs the idempotent JdbcAuditLogService.initSchema() at startup to create the aiact_audit_log table if absent. Set false when a migration tool (Flyway / Liquibase) owns the DDL so the application is never schema-privileged.

properties.name: aiact.retention-sweeper.enabled
properties.description: When true (default), a scheduled task prunes audit records older than aiact.retention. Disable when retention is handled externally or in tests.

properties.name: aiact.retention-sweeper.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the retention sweeper. Defaults to 03:00 UTC daily.

values.description: File-backed sink: one .ndjson file per system under aiact.log-dir.
Table-backed sink: HMAC-chained records in aiact_audit_log on the application DataSource.
